battle.name: 墨西哥獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 墨西哥獨立戰爭始於1810年瓜納華托州多洛雷斯的起義，之後擴展為西班牙殖民當局與墨西哥獨立力量之間的長期戰爭。火繩槍（Matchlock musket）於1520年列裝，是西班牙陸軍在16世紀步兵體系中採用的槍械型號。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries: 墨西哥獨立戰爭（1810—1821）發生於西班牙王國正捲入半島戰爭、尚未恢復中央控制之時，戰區則是新西班牙總督轄區。1810年的交戰者是起義各省軍隊與效忠西班牙王室的新西班牙軍；到1814年，莫雷洛斯建立的南方軍與各地殘部已不屬於同一永久總部，西班牙王軍則在費利克斯·馬里亞·卡列哈等指揮官率領下奪回大城市和主要道路。1817年，弗朗西斯科·哈維爾·米納率獨立縱隊加入新西班牙，起義仍沒有全國統一的政府。1821年，阿古斯丁·德·伊圖爾比德率領的三保證軍與維森特·瓜雷羅的部隊合作，而胡安·奧多尼烏代表西班牙在科爾多瓦達成協議，戰爭才以新國家取得獨立的形式收束。因此，此處的墨西哥是起義各方對未來國家的稱呼；1810—1820年的正式殖民地名稱仍是新西班牙。主要戰區由瓜納華托、巴亞多利德、墨西哥城、薩爾瓦蒂耶拉和瓜達拉哈拉一路連到南部的伊瓜拉與莫雷洛斯活動區，並非在固定地點進行的一場兩軍會戰。
countriesEn: The Mexican War of Independence of 1810–1821 unfolded while the Spanish monarchy was embroiled in the Peninsular War and had not restored central control; its theater was the viceroyalty of New Spain. In 1810, the belligerents were provincial insurgent columns and the New Spanish army loyal to the Spanish crown. By 1814, the southern army created by José María Morelos and the surviving provincial detachments no longer answered to one permanent headquarters, while the Royalist Army under commanders such as Félix María Calleja recovered major cities and main roads. In 1817, Francisco Javier Mina entered New Spain with an independent column, but the insurgents still had no national government. In 1821, the Army of the Three Guarantees led by Agustín de Iturbide cooperated with forces under Vicente Guerrero, while Juan O'Donojú reached an agreement on behalf of Spain at Córdoba, bringing the war to a close with the independence of a new state. Mexico therefore designated the future country among the insurgents' names; throughout 1810–1820, New Spain remained the formal colonial name. The principal theater connected Guanajuato, Valladolid, Mexico City, Salvatierra, and Guadalajara with Iguala and the southern zone of operations. This was not a single set-piece battle fought at one fixed location.
people: 主要指揮者來自不同地區，其權力也隨戰局而變化。1810年9月，米格爾·伊達爾戈以多洛雷斯民兵上尉身分率領起義縱隊；初期隊伍混合原住民、混血與克里奧爾士兵，沒有統一常備編制。何塞·瑪麗亞·莫雷洛斯建立米卻肯省區軍，尼古拉斯·布拉沃在格雷羅省作戰，伊格納西奧·洛佩斯·拉洪則維持北方軍；伊達爾戈於1811年7月30日被處決，莫雷洛斯於1813年12月22日被處決，瓜雷羅延續了南方抵抗。西班牙方面，費利克斯·馬里亞·卡列哈長期指揮王軍追擊起義者，弗朗西斯科·哈維爾·米納於1817年率獨立縱隊進入新西班牙。阿古斯丁·德·伊圖爾比德起初在王軍一方作戰，後來轉入南方起義軍，並於1821年以三保證軍最高指揮身分與瓜雷羅共同締結協議。末期的西班牙代表胡安·奧多尼烏以總督府總司令身分簽署科爾多瓦協議。雙方作戰單位包含省區縱隊、步兵營、步兵連、騎兵隊、火炮隊和地方民兵，但早期指揮權主要依靠地方追隨與軍事聲望，而非固定的全國階級。
peopleEn: The principal commanders came from different regions, and their authority changed with the fortunes of the war. In September 1810, Miguel Hidalgo led an insurgent column in his capacity as a militia captain at Dolores. His early force combined Indigenous, mestizo, and Creole soldiers and had no unified standing establishment. José María Morelos formed the Michoacán provincial army, Nicolás Bravo operated in Guerrero province, and Ignacio López Rayón maintained the Army of the North. Hidalgo was executed on 30 July 1811, Morelos on 22 December 1813, while Guerrero continued the southern resistance. On the Spanish side, Félix María Calleja commanded Royalist columns against the insurgents for many years, and Francisco Javier Mina entered New Spain with an independent column in 1817. Agustín de Iturbide initially fought for the Royalists, later joined the southern insurgents, and in 1821 concluded the agreement with Guerrero as the senior commander of the Army of the Three Guarantees. Juan O'Donojú, the Spanish representative at the end, signed the Córdoba agreement in his capacity as captain general of the viceroyalty. The forces of both sides included provincial columns, infantry battalions, companies, cavalry units, artillery batteries, and local militias, but early command rested mainly on regional followings and military reputation rather than a fixed national hierarchy.
kits: 1810年前後可確認在新西班牙流通或服役的步槍，包括英製Brown Bess，即1760式家族燧發滑膛槍，名義口徑約0.601英寸；它雖已不是英軍當時最新的標準式，仍在美洲廣泛流傳。西班牙陸軍則使用1795式Charleville型燧發滑膛槍，名義口徑約0.605英寸。此外，1791式西班牙步兵劍配給部分步兵、軍官與士官；十八世紀西班牙軍常用的四磅、六磅與八磅級青銅滑膛野砲，也見於新西班牙各支軍隊。Brown Bess的典型英軍紙包彈包含一顆約0.577英寸的彈丸和64格令黑火藥；1795式步槍的紙包彈則把按軍規定量裝用的黑火藥與一顆步槍彈結合，實際藥量不得一概視為相同。四、六與八磅砲使用實心彈和霰彈，火炮隊由炮車、火馬與隨軍備件共同行動。裝備並未統一：起義軍從西班牙軍械庫取得槍械，各省隊伍也會沿用不同口徑。步兵把紙包彈放在腰囊，餘彈由彈藥箱補充；火炮備彈、軍械與糧食依靠馬匹和驢隊輸送，補充點主要是城鎮軍械庫、駐軍地點及作戰地區內取得的儲備，因此道路、宿營地和水源直接影響持續作戰能力。
kitsEn: The muskets confirmed as issued or circulating in New Spain around 1810 included the British Brown Bess of the Model 1760 family, a flintlock smoothbore musket with a nominal caliber of approximately 0.601 inch. Although no longer the newest British standard, it remained widely distributed in the Americas. The Spanish army used the Model 1795 Charleville-pattern flintlock smoothbore musket, with a nominal caliber of approximately 0.605 inch. The Model 1791 Spanish infantry sword was issued to some infantrymen, officers, and noncommissioned officers, while four-, six-, and eight-pounder bronze smoothbore field pieces standard in the eighteenth-century Spanish army also appeared in New Spanish formations. A typical British Brown Bess paper cartridge contained one 0.577-inch musket ball and 64 grains of black powder. The Model 1795 paper cartridge similarly combined a regulation quantity of black powder with one musket ball, although the prescribed charge could not be treated as identical in every unit. Four-, six-, and eight-pounder guns fired solid shot and canister shot, and artillery teams operated their pieces with limbers, teams, and traveling equipment. Equipment was not uniform: insurgents obtained weapons from Spanish arsenals, while provincial formations retained different calibers. Infantrymen carried cartridges in their pouches and drew ammunition from reserve boxes. Artillery ammunition, weapons, and provisions moved with horse and mule teams, receiving replenishment chiefly at urban arsenals, garrison sites, and captured stores. Roads, bivouacs, and water sources therefore directly affected the ability of a formation to remain in the field.
tactics: 作戰方式隨起義軍逐漸獲得兵力而改變。1810年的伊達爾戈縱隊依靠快速行軍和集中兵力，直接強攻瓜納華托的阿隆迪加 fortress，並在蒙特德拉斯克魯塞斯山區攻擊西班牙車隊；卡列哈則在卡爾德隆橋利用道路控制、炮兵與騎兵集中兵力，迫使起義軍分散撤退。莫雷洛斯把南方軍整編為師、營，設置炮兵，依次圍攻巴亞多利德、瓜納華托與阿卡普爾科，並在1812年1月進入墨西哥州後於查爾科一帶受挫，隨後南返。瓜雷羅在格雷羅省山區與海岸區使用較小縱隊，以短距離襲擊、轉移和返回原駐地的方式保存兵力。西班牙王軍控制城市、堡壘和主要道路，以縱隊往返駐軍地、護送糧車並攻擊孤立起義部隊；米納在1817年則以獨立縱隊襲擊王軍交通線。伊圖爾比德的常備軍在末期把正規步兵、炮兵與地方部隊結合，並在軍事壓力與談判並行下迫使西班牙當局接受協議。
tacticsEn: Methods of warfare changed as the insurgents acquired greater strength. Hidalgo's column in 1810 relied on rapid movement and concentrated numbers to assault the Alhóndiga fortress at Guanajuato and to attack a Spanish wagon train in the mountain defile of Monte de las Cruces. At the Bridge of Calderón, Calleja concentrated artillery and cavalry while controlling the road, forcing the insurgents to disperse and retreat. Morelos reorganized the southern army into divisions and battalions, added artillery, and conducted the sieges of Valladolid, Guanajuato, and Acapulco. After entering the State of Mexico in January 1812, his army was checked around Chalco and subsequently returned south. Guerrero used smaller columns in the mountains and coastal districts of Guerrero province, relying on short incursions, movement, and return to established positions to preserve his forces. The Royalist Army controlled cities, fortresses, and principal roads, moving columns between garrisons, escorting supply trains, and attacking isolated insurgent formations. Mina used an independent column to strike Royalist communications in 1817. In the closing phase, Iturbide combined regular infantry and artillery with local forces and, while applying military pressure, entered negotiations that led Spain to accept the agreement.
data: 1810年9月16日，米格爾·伊達爾戈在多洛雷斯宣布起義；9月27日，起義軍攻下瓜納華托的阿隆迪加，隨後經萊昂前往巴亞多利德。9月30日，軍隊在巴亞多利德公布廢除奴隸制度的處置，10月初抵達墨西哥城 outskirts，沒有展開攻城戰便於10月4日撤離；10月30日，伊達爾戈在蒙特德拉斯克魯塞斯擊敗西班牙車隊。1811年1月17日，卡列哈在瓜達拉哈拉附近的卡爾德隆橋擊敗起義軍。伊達爾戈經薩爾瓦蒂耶拉與聖路易斯波托西向北行進，3月6日在巴漢井被俘，7月30日在奇瓦瓦被處決。1811年，莫雷洛斯在米卻肯活動，2月於庫埃納瓦卡取勝，9月6日占領巴亞多利德；瓜雷羅則於11月27日在蒂斯特拉擊敗王軍。1812年1月，莫雷洛斯進入墨西哥州，在查爾科一帶受挫後返回南方；同年11月至1813年4月，南方軍包圍阿卡普爾科，但未能迫使守軍投降。1813年11月5日，莫雷洛斯在奇特拉附近被俘；11月6日，阿帕青萬的代表仍宣布獨立，次年1月遭伊圖爾比德壓制。1814至1816年，王軍摧毀或迫使主要起義縱隊分散；米納於1817年建立獨立縱隊，活動至1818年。1820年西班牙自由革命削弱王權；1821年2月24日瓜雷羅與伊圖爾比德發布伊瓜拉計畫，8月24日與奧多尼烏簽署科爾多瓦協議，9月27日三保證軍進入墨西哥城並舉行獨立儀式。
dataEn: On 16 September 1810, Miguel Hidalgo proclaimed the revolt at Dolores. On 27 September, the insurgents captured the Alhóndiga at Guanajuato and moved through León toward Valladolid. On 30 September, the army proclaimed the abolition of slavery at Valladolid. It reached the outskirts of Mexico City in early October but fought no battle for the city and withdrew on 4 October. On 30 October, Hidalgo defeated a Spanish wagon convoy at Monte de las Cruces. On 17 January 1811, Calleja defeated the insurgents at the Bridge of Calderón near Guadalajara. Hidalgo moved north through Salvatierra and San Luis Potosí, was captured at the Wells of Baján on 6 March, and was executed at Chihuahua on 30 July. In 1811, Morelos operated from Michoacán, won at Cuernavaca in February, and occupied Valladolid on 6 September. Guerrero defeated a Royalist army at Tixtla on 27 November. In January 1812, Morelos entered the State of Mexico, was checked around Chalco, and returned south. From November 1812 to April 1813, southern forces besieged Acapulco but did not compel its garrison to surrender. Morelos was captured near Chetla on 5 November 1813. On 6 November, the deputies at Apatzingán nevertheless proclaimed independence, and Iturbide suppressed the congress in the following January. From 1814 to 1816, Royalist forces destroyed or dispersed the principal organized insurgent columns. Mina maintained an independent column from 1817 to 1818. The liberal revolution in Spain weakened the monarchy in 1820. Guerrero and Iturbide issued the Plan of Iguala on 24 February 1821. On 24 August they signed the Córdoba agreement with O'Donojú, and on 27 September the Army of the Three Guarantees entered Mexico City for the independence ceremony.
cause: 戰爭的長期原因包括波旁改革造成的中央集權，以及新西班牙本地出身的軍官和行政人員對半島人士控制高級軍職與總督府任命的不滿。1808年查理斯四世退位、費爾南多七世退位及約瑟夫·波拿巴即位，使西班牙王位繼承和殖民政權合法性同時陷入危機；各地總督、Junta與教區機構分別宣誓效忠，逐漸形成互相競爭的權威。伊達爾戈的行動最初並非按計畫建立一個完整的獨立國家，而是由地方軍隊對政治秩序的不滿所觸發。由於半島受到法國入侵牽制，馬德里無法向新西班牙持續輸送足夠兵力；王軍雖保有城市、堡壘和部分正規軍，卻難以同時消滅各地分散的起義軍。莫雷洛斯及其後續代表把軍事叛亂轉化為正式宣布獨立、建立軍政機關的全國事業，使省區戰爭具有國家憲制層次。1820年西班牙自由革命削弱了王室正當性，1821年奧多尼烏又缺乏恢復全面戰爭的兵力與政治授權，因此西班牙本土政治危機、新西班牙軍事消耗及地方軍隊的協議能力共同造成轉向獨立。
causeEn: Long-term causes included Bourbon centralization and the resentment of locally born officers and administrators in New Spain over the control of senior commands and viceregal appointments by Peninsular officials. The abdications of Charles IV and Ferdinand VII in 1808 and the enthronement of Joseph Bonaparte created a simultaneous crisis of royal succession and colonial authority in Spain. Viceroys, juntas, and ecclesiastical authorities declared their own loyalties and became competing sources of legitimate power. Hidalgo's movement did not begin as a planned attempt to establish a fully independent national state; it arose from a provincial military force responding to political disorder. Because Napoleon's invasion occupied the Peninsula, Madrid could not continuously supply sufficient forces to New Spain. Royalists retained cities, fortresses, and regular troops, yet could not eliminate all the dispersed provincial insurgent columns at once. Morelos and the delegates who followed him transformed a regional revolt into a formal declaration of independence and the construction of military and governmental institutions, giving the provincial wars a national constitutional dimension. The liberal revolution of 1820 weakened royal legitimacy. O'Donojú lacked both the troops to resume a full war and the political authority required to reject the local military settlement. The crisis in metropolitan Spain, the military exhaustion of New Spain, and the negotiating capacity of its provincial forces therefore combined to produce independence.
impact: 王軍在1811至1813年重新奪取多數城市，卻未能恢復對provincial routes和南部游擊區的完整軍事控制。阿帕青萬代表於1813年作出的獨立宣告雖未立即建立能控制全國的政府，卻成為後續國家合法性的重要依據；省區軍、軍政機關與地方政治領導也從此成為獨立後的重要軍事力量。1814年之後，起義不再由單一大軍統率，戰爭轉為王軍肅清、莫雷洛斯舊部、山區游擊隊和米納獨立縱隊並存的消耗局面。這種分裂削弱了西班牙重新征服新西班牙的可能，卻使瓜雷羅等南方指揮者能持續維持組織。戰爭結束後，三保證軍沒有立即解除武裝，成為伊圖爾比德在1822年建立帝國的主要力量；帝國隨即在1823年被推翻，但獨立國家本身仍然延續。由此產生的核心影響，是殖民地軍政權威終止、軍事單位轉化為新國家的政治力量，以及最高指揮權歸屬仍未完全解決。
impactEn: The Royalist Army recovered most major cities between 1811 and 1813 but never restored complete military control over the provincial routes or the southern guerrilla zones. Although the Apatzingán declaration of independence in 1813 did not create a government able to control the entire country, it became an important basis for later state legitimacy. Provincial armies, military administrations, and regional leaders also emerged as major political forces in the independent state. After 1814 no single insurgent army controlled the war. It became an attritional contest among Royalist pacification forces, Morelos's surviving units, mountain columns, Guerrero's forces, and Mina's independent corps. This division prevented Spain from reconquering New Spain while allowing southern commanders such as Guerrero to retain organized forces. After the war ended, the Army of the Three Guarantees did not immediately disarm and became the principal military foundation of Iturbide's empire in 1822. The monarchy was overthrown in 1823, but the independent state survived. The central consequences were therefore the end of colonial military and governmental authority, the conversion of military formations into political power within the new state, and the unresolved location of supreme command.
result: 到1821年，軍事結果並非西班牙王軍在戰場上被全數消滅，而是馬德里已無力為新西班牙各駐軍提供一致的命令、補充與中央後援。伊圖爾比德的常備三保證軍與瓜雷羅掌握的地方兵力控制了主要政治路線，的王軍單位則分散於城市和駐軍點，難以再組織縱隊進攻。1821年8月24日，伊圖爾比德與總司令胡安·奧多尼烏簽署科爾多瓦協議；依協議，墨西哥成為獨立國家、西班牙與墨西哥由一位波旁君主組成共同王國、羅馬天主教為正式國教，政治制度則暫由君主制框架下的臨時政府處理。這三項內容是條約條件，而不是單純停火。西班牙中央政府後來沒有以原形式批准協議，實際撤軍也分階段進行，但西班牙無法恢復戰爭，使協議確定了獨立的事實。9月27日三保證軍進入墨西哥城，舉行獨立儀式，1810年以來以西班牙殖民政權為對象的戰爭至此結束。戰爭確實建立了獨立國家，卻沒有同時解決墨西哥應採君主制、共和制或聯邦制的問題，伊圖爾比德的軍事優勢因而成為下一階段政治衝突的直接來源。
resultEn: By 1821, the military result was not the complete destruction of the Royalist Army in battle. Madrid had lost the capacity to provide New Spain's garrisons with unified command, resupply, and central support. Iturbide's regular Army of the Three Guarantees and the local forces under Guerrero controlled the principal political routes, while Royalist units remained dispersed among cities and garrison posts and could no longer assemble columns for a general offensive. On 24 August 1821, Iturbide and Captain General Juan O'Donojú signed the Córdoba agreement. Under its terms, Mexico would be an independent state; Spain and Mexico would form a common kingdom under a Bourbon monarch; and Roman Catholicism would be the established religion, while the political system would initially be administered through a provisional government within the monarchical framework. These provisions were treaty conditions rather than a simple ceasefire. The central government in Spain did not later approve the agreement in its original form, and the evacuation also occurred in stages, but Spain could not resume the war, making the agreement effective recognition of independence. On 27 September, the Army of the Three Guarantees entered Mexico City and the independence ceremony took place. The war directed against Spanish colonial authority from 1810 had ended. It established an independent state but did not settle whether Mexico should have a monarchy, a republic, or a federation. Iturbide's military advantage therefore became the immediate source of the next political conflict.
